note: Grade derivation (plan.md 6.3). A number's source is <source_kind>:<locator>; the grade is looked up by (source_kind, value_kind) and never self-reported. Check 2 compares. Open question 14-12 may revise database and predicted rows; a revision is a new row, and the old row stays with retired_on. 2026-11-09: the computed row gains with_basis (the grade follows the worst input where a basis names them); the flat E4 stays for a computed number whose inputs are not on its card, rather than being retired, because records that carry such numbers are append-only.

rules.with_basis: max(E4, the worst grade among the rows the basis names)
rules.note: Settled 2026-11-08 (plan.md 14-12, "Take all six"): a computed number inherits the worst grade among its inputs and is never better than E4. Where a basis names the input rows (a parameter_sheet row or bound), checks 2 and 19 derive the grade from them; a computed number with no basis (numbers[] of other cards) keeps the flat E4, since its inputs are not on the card.
